verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm is a Relais & Châteaux resort in Walland, Tennessee, in the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the sun rises over the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains, the morning mist fades to unveil one of America's greatest hidden treasures: Blackberry Farm, a Relais & Châteaux resort in Walland, Tennessee.

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm was named a MICHELIN Two-Key destination in 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Blackberry Farm has been recognized as a MICHELIN Two-Key destination.

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm brings together wellness, culinary, outdoor adventure and hospitality experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Blackberry Farm seamlessly infuses wellness, culinary, outdoor adventure and hospitality into every experience

verified_facts.text: Accommodations include Historic Rooms, Estate Rooms, Cottage Suites, Hill Cottages and multi-bedroom houses, all furnished with fine antiques and art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Historic Rooms, Estate Rooms, Cottage Suites, Hill Cottages and multi-bedroom houses, all beautifully appointed and furnished with fine antiques and art.

verified_facts.text: The interiors are designed by Blackberry Farm Design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interiors designed by Blackberry Farm Design

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm sits on a hillside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Blackberry Farm sits on a hillside commanding one of the most spectacular views you can find.

verified_facts.text: A dedicated concierge team helps plan stays, curating experiences for romantic getaways, family vacations or corporate retreats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether we’re curating unique experiences for romantic getaways, family vacations or corporate retreats, we ensure an unparalleled luxury experience.

verified_facts.text: Traditional rates include accommodation plus dinner on the day of arrival through breakfast on the day of departure in the resort's restaurants during traditional meal hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Traditional rates are based on double occupancy and offer nightly accommodations as well as dinner on the day of arrival through breakfast on the day of departure within our restaurants during traditional meal hours.

verified_facts.text: Groups can bring corporate events, celebrations or incentive trips, with views of the Great Smoky Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our award-winning staff will help curate an unforgettable experience for your corporate events, celebrations or incentive trips.

verified_facts.text: Guests can stroll through blooming gardens in spring and enjoy crackling fires in fall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you're strolling through blooming gardens in the Spring or enjoying crackling fires in the Fall, our accommodations offer a perfect sanctuary year-round.

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm is less than half an hour from Knoxville's McGhee Tyson Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Blackberry is less than half an hour from Knoxville’s McGhee Tyson Airport, but it feels a world apart from city life.

verified_facts.text: The Farm was built in 1940, and Sandy and Kreis Beall opened it as an intimate country inn in 1976.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built in 1940, the Farm was later acquired by Sandy Beall, the founder of Ruby Tuesday, who with his wife Kreis opened it as an intimate country inn in 1976

verified_facts.text: The room aesthetic mixes rustic country chic with bright, functional modernity, with floral wallpaper prints, stone chimneys and overstuffed sofas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The aesthetic mixes rustic country chic with bright, functional modernity, delivering floral wallpaper prints, stone chimneys, and overstuffed sofas

verified_facts.text: The Barn, the Farm's fanciest restaurant, is a timber-frame structure the Bealls moved piece by piece from Pennsylvania Dutch country.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Barn, a timber-frame structure which the Bealls moved, piece by piece, from its original location in Pennsylvania Dutch country

verified_facts.text: Near the Barn lies a wine cellar holding more than 160,000 bottles.
verified_facts.excerpt: is the second largest wine cellar in America, containing more than 160,000 bottles

verified_facts.text: The Wellhouse spa offers treatments, a little cafe serving tonics and juices, a pool, and yoga and movement classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s a little cafe where you can order a tonic or a juice—or a cocktail, if you prefer—to take out to the pool. This is also where you’ll find the Farm’s top-notch yoga and movement classes.

verified_facts.text: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is Blackberry Farm's next-door neighbor, and its western end is quieter.
verified_facts.excerpt: One of Blackberry Farm’s many appealing qualities is its next-door neighbor, Great Smoky Mountains National Park. Though this is the most-visited park in the entire system, it’s a lot quieter over here on the western end.

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm breeds Lagotto Romagnolos, Italian water dogs used to hunt truffles, and guests can visit the kennels.
verified_facts.excerpt: One of the signature features of Blackberry Farm is its breeding program for Lagotto Romagnolos, the fleecy and very intelligent Italian water dogs often used to hunt truffles. Be sure to make time to visit the kennels

verified_facts.text: Families have guided adventure programs in the Smokies, ceramics and painting classes, and Camp Blackberry for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are also family adventure programs out in the Smokies with a guide, ceramics and painting classes, and Camp Blackberry where you can drop the little ones for a morning or afternoon

verified_facts.text: Half of the Farm's 4,200 acres is in conservation, and sustainable agriculture is one of its cornerstones.
verified_facts.excerpt: Half of the Farm’s 4,200 total acres is in conservation.

verified_facts.text: The property has a network of hiking and biking trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sam Beall also oversaw the creation of the property’s network of hiking and biking trails

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler advises guests to plan to dress for dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: you should plan to dress for dinner with a strappy dress or a seersucker jacket

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm offers intimate live music performances featuring some of the biggest names in the South.
verified_facts.excerpt: intimate live music performances featuring some of the biggest names in the South

verified_facts.text: Blackberry Farm has 68 guest accommodations.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer 68 guest accommodations
